author: Myv
body:
Age: 15 
Timezone: GMT (Greenwich Mean Time)
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes.
Do you have access to Skype? Yes.
Do you have access to a recording software? I hopefully will have in the next week because of my Media Rank.

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?
I am Media on here and I am a moderator on a private build server, but nothing in terms of wholesome leadership on Minecraft servers as of right now.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?
My biggest weakness is that I am lazy. I understand this, but I do not think it will effect me too much because I will work 100% on the task in hand because it is something I actually want to do.

My biggest strength is that I am really active and have leadership skills in real life. I have been a leader in Scout groups and I am actually really mature in the right situations that require attention and professionalism, so I can capitalise on these respective aspects efficiently to do my job well.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
I can help attending to potential hackers and rule-breakers and also help to suggest ideas for improving the server whilst retaining professional policy and attitude. I think that as a team we can all progress forward and work harder on the server than ever before to provide a great server to the community, even more so than at this current time.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
A leader needs to be someone who can be responsible for their peers and show maturity in potentially difficult situations, whilst guiding those forward to the best possible outcomes. I consider myself to be a leader because I have previous experiences in real life and I strongly feel I can integrate these characteristics in to the server to show leadership. I also enjoy leadership online far more than in real life because I am actually a quiet person at heart, but I am mature.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
This is obviously not the case for every other player but as I said previously I am extremely active and I also am able to show maturity but also have a laugh at the correct times, of course. I am also quite a philosophical person so I always look at things from multiple different perspectives to consider the best options for different things.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?
To sum it up, maturity, well-being and respect to everyone in the community. I am for equality so I will show equal tolerance and respect to everyone I come into contact with for whatever reason that may be.

How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 
Around 2 hours per weeknight (around 6pm - 8pm) and a little longer at weekends but for about the same hours. I am very active when I am not at school, and if for example it was in the morning and there was no moderator on, I would probably be able to come on within a few minutes to attend to a situation that needs to be addressed.

CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
I would record them with software for future reference to show to whoever may need to see it to confirm a ban evader. If I were able to collect the nametags each time, an Administrator or such can then potentially find the IP's to see if it is the same person, or many different ones, and if they are hacking, they can of course ban them accordingly.

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on TeamSpeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
I would probably poke him on TeamSpeak at first to ask why he is committing these actions and if I received no reply then I would contact a higher staff member privately to complain about his or her actions, and they can then analyse their future actions or address the situation. I would also monitor them for a little while previously to see if they persist on doing it.

A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
I would have to tell them the unfortunate news that the file is corrupted and more than likely the player would not believe me, so I will have to either insist that it is true or get someone else to confirm it for me. However, I do not want to rely on other people all the time, so I believe that if there is no evidence for someone's actions, they should be innocent. It is like in real life - if someone goes to court convicted of a crime but there is no evidence for it happening, they should be innocent UNTIL proven guilty.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
Screenshot that screenshot and show the correct staff members about it. Although they have access to it, they should not be leaking potentially confidential information around to those who shouldn't see it, which is something I feel strongly about. Therefore I would immediately report it to the correct place.

One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
I would possibly express why I believe it was the wrong decision but I would not bring anyone else into the situation as I would not wish to start an argument. I would just politely explain why I believe it was the wrong idea to do whatever it might have been, just to get my point across.

CRITERIA 3: OTHER

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
Quite a lot really. Avicus has given me a lot of fun times and memories in 3 years, so I feel it is only right I return the favour by helping to run the server efficiently and be part of a wonderful staff team. 

How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
As I said, Avicus has provided me with a lot of fun and memories so it means a lot to me. In all honesty, it is the only Minecraft server I have ever stuck with for longer than 6 months, which says a lot about the server. The community are amazing and therefore I really want to help out and am passionate about doing so.

Do you speak any other languages than English?
I am semi-fluent in German but only from school learning. I probably could not hold a conversation in German.

Do you have anything else to add to your application?
I just wanted to sum up my application by saying that I am active, mature and willing to help out in the Moderating side of Avicus by attending to situations whenever needed and also by suggesting and helping out improving the server as a whole. Thank you very much.
